picked_rationale.C3: C3 (necessity + sufficiency) is the most scientifically central claim: the necessity-yes / sufficiency-no asymmetry is the study's key publishable finding, it recurs on Gemma-2-9B (M5), and a model-swap variant (Gemma-2-9B) directly stress-tests whether this asymmetry is robust across model families — the highest-stakes robustness question in the study.
